author: third blind subagent (never saw the router, its exemplars or earlier sets)

questions.question: who owns the kafka order queue these days?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(c {id:'queue'}) RETURN t.id -> team-checkout. 'kafka order queue' is the name of Datastore queue; OWNED_AT shows team-checkout since 2025-09-10 with no end.

questions.question: Which team is fraud-detection with now?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(c {id:'fraud-detection'}) RETURN t.id -> team-platform. OWNED_AT: team-payments 2025-09-10 to 2026-08-06, team-platform from 2026-08-06 (to null), so the current owner is team-platform, not payments.

questions.question: Quick one: who's the owning team for the exec revenue KPI?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(c {id:'kpi.exec_revenue'}) RETURN t.id -> team-data (KPI name 'Executive Revenue KPI').

questions.question: I need to get a change into the shipping quote calculator. Which team owns it?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(c {id:'quote'}) RETURN t.id -> team-catalog. Service quote is named 'shipping quote calculator'; note it is owned by catalog, not storefront (which owns shipping).

questions.question: Back in March 2026, which team owned the ad service?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[r:OWNED_AT]->(c {id:'ad'}) RETURN t.id, r.from, r.to -> team-storefront 2025-09-10..2026-08-31, team-growth from 2026-08-31. March 2026 falls in the storefront window.

questions.question: When inc-h006 happened, who was responsible for fraud detection?
questions.notes: MATCH (i:Incident {id:'inc-h006'}) RETURN i.onset_at -> 2026-07-17T12:51Z (fraud-detection is AFFECTED role impacted). MATCH (t:Team)-[r:OWNED_AT]->(c {id:'fraud-detection'}) -> team-payments 2025-09-10..2026-08-06, team-platform after. Onset is inside the payments window.

questions.question: who had ownership of ad as of 2026-09-15
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[r:OWNED_AT]->(c {id:'ad'}) RETURN t.id, r.from, r.to -> team-growth from 2026-08-31 (to null); team-storefront ended 2026-08-31. 2026-09-15 is in the growth window.

questions.question: Who's done most of the actual coding on payment?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:COMMITTED]->(c {id:'payment'}) RETURN p.id, r.n ORDER BY r.n DESC -> p-017 32, p-036 22, p-030 14, p-034 8, p-004 7, p-038 7 (cross-checked with AUTHORED->Commit->TOUCHES->File->PART_OF, same counts). p-017 also RESOLVED the most payment-caused incidents. Top three are essential.

questions.question: anyone who really knows the quote service code?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:COMMITTED]->(c {id:'quote'}) RETURN p.id, r.n -> p-035 25 commits; everyone else <= 2 (p-006 2, p-016 2, p-012 1, p-027 1). p-035 is active.

questions.question: I'm digging into the recommendation cache. Who has worked on recommendation before?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:COMMITTED]->(c {id:'recommendation'}) -> p-020 16 (inactive, left 2026-08-30), p-010 10, p-013 10, p-031 9, p-035 6. RESOLVED on recommendation-caused incidents: p-013 3 (inc-h010, h023, h034), p-020 2 (h017, h022), p-031 1. p-020 and p-013 are top on both signals; p-010/p-031 are nice to have.

questions.question: Who has been changing exec_revenue_metric.sql?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:COMMITTED]->(c {id:'exec_revenue_metric.sql'}) -> p-009 15, p-026 5, p-029 5, p-033 3, p-015 2. RESOLVED incidents caused there: inc-h009 p-009, inc-h031 p-026, inc-h038 p-026. p-009 and p-026 essential.

questions.question: Who's worked on the currency service, and have any of them left?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:COMMITTED]->(c {id:'currency'}) RETURN p.id, r.n, p.active -> p-032 19 (active=false, valid_to 2026-10-03), p-038 6, p-027 3, p-028 1, p-034 1. The main contributor p-032 has left; p-038 is the top active one.

questions.question: Did we ever decide whether checkout should wait for the order confirmation email to go out?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(:Service {id:'checkout'}) RETURN d.id, d.title, d.status -> ADR-004 'Order confirmation email is best-effort', active, rule checkout.email.blocking == false; nothing SUPERSEDES it.

questions.question: Is the off-peak window for catalog database migrations still the rule, or did that change?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision {id:'ADR-009'}) RETURN d.status -> superseded; MATCH (n)-[s:SUPERSEDES]->(:Decision {id:'ADR-009'}) RETURN n.id, s.at -> ADR-021 (2026-06-03, online migrations, active, the head). Answer must name both.

questions.question: what's the agreed retry policy for the payment client, and does it still stand?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(:Service {id:'payment'}) -> ADR-012 (timeout) and ADR-013 'Payment client keeps >= 2 retries' (rule_key payment.client.retries, active, not superseded). Retries -> ADR-013.

questions.question: What decisions are in force for the postgres product database right now?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(:Datastore {id:'astronomy-db'}) -> ADR-009 (superseded) and ADR-021 (active, nothing supersedes it). Datastore astronomy-db is named 'postgres product database'. In force now: ADR-021 only.

questions.question: Who signed off on moving catalog schema changes to online migrations? Are they still with us?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(d:Decision {id:'ADR-021'}) RETURN p.id, p.active -> p-006 Florin Ashcombe (lead) and p-016 Pavel Kingsbarrow, both active, both MEMBER_OF team-catalog (to null), which owns product-catalog/astronomy-db.

questions.question: who decided the confirmation email is best-effort, and can I still go ask them?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(d:Decision {id:'ADR-004'}) RETURN p.id, p.active, p.valid_to -> p-019 Soren Orrinwood only; active=false, valid_to 2026-07-19 (MEMBER_OF team-checkout ended then). So: no, the only decider has left.

questions.question: Who came up with the original off-peak migration rule for astronomy-db, and are they still here?
questions.notes: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(d:Decision {id:'ADR-009'}) RETURN p.id, p.active -> p-025 Yara Umberfield, active=false, valid_to 2026-09-16. ADR-009 is itself superseded by ADR-021 (nice to have).

questions.question: Who put the weekend freeze on payment changes in place?
questions.notes: MATCH (x:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(p:Policy)-[:FREEZES]->(s) RETURN p.id, x.id, s.id -> POL-freeze-payment-weekend (no payment changes Fri 16:00 to Mon 09:00 IST, active, decided_by p-004) decided by p-004 Dorian Marrowby (active, payments lead); FREEZES payment.

questions.question: Order event consumers are falling behind on kafka again. Is there a runbook for that?
questions.notes: MATCH (r:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(x) WHERE x.id IN ['queue','sym-lag-queue','accounting'] RETURN r.id -> rb-kafka-lag 'Order queue consumer lag' (human; RUNBOOK_FOR accounting and sym-lag-queue, target queue) and the derived rb-derived-73947d9c45 'open issue queue' (nice to have).

questions.question: recs latency just spiked after a release and product-catalog is getting hammered. what's the procedure?
questions.notes: MATCH (r:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(x) WHERE x.id IN ['recommendation','sym-latency-recommendation'] RETURN r.id -> rb-recs-cache 'Recommendation cache stampede' (human, RUNBOOK_FOR recommendation + sym-latency-recommendation) and derived rb-derived-3cfa56a626 (flip flag recommendationCacheFailure, nice to have).

questions.question: cart error rate is climbing. Do we have a playbook for that?
questions.notes: MATCH (r:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(x) WHERE x.id IN ['cart','sym-error_rate-cart'] RETURN r.id, r.title -> only rb-derived-b085b89b99 'Derived: flip flag cartFailure (worked 3x)' via Symptom sym-error_rate-cart (DERIVED_FROM pm-h001, pm-h013, pm-h033). No human runbook targets cart.

questions.question: The exec revenue number jumped overnight. What steps do we follow?
questions.notes: MATCH (r:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(s:Symptom {target_id:'kpi.exec_revenue'}) RETURN r.id -> rb-derived-32def3f1f2 'Derived: data repair exec_revenue_metric.sql (worked 3x)' via sym-kpi_jump-kpi.exec_revenue (DERIVED_FROM pm-h009, pm-h031, pm-h038). The only runbook for that symptom.

questions.question: If valkey goes down, what breaks?
questions.notes: Datastore cache is named 'valkey cart cache'. MATCH p=(a:Node {id:'cache'})-[:PROPAGATES_TO*1..10]->(b) RETURN b.id, min(length(p)) -> cart 1; checkout 2, frontend 2; agent, frontend-proxy, mcp 3; chatbot 4. Essential: the first two hops.

questions.question: what's the fallout if the quote service dies?
questions.notes: MATCH p=(a:Node {id:'quote'})-[:PROPAGATES_TO*1..10]->(b) RETURN b.id, min(length(p)) -> shipping 1; checkout 2, frontend 2; agent, frontend-proxy, mcp 3; chatbot 4.

questions.question: Suppose payment falls over completely. What's downstream of it, all the way to the revenue numbers?
questions.notes: MATCH p=(a:Node {id:'payment'})-[:PROPAGATES_TO*1..10]->(b) RETURN b.id, min(length(p)) -> checkout 1, raw.raw_orders 1 (cross-domain edge); frontend 2, staging.stg_orders 2; marts.fct_revenue 3, agent/frontend-proxy/mcp 3; marts.exec_revenue_metric 4, chatbot 4; kpi.exec_revenue 5; dash.exec_morning 6. The question asks for the path to the revenue numbers, so kpi.exec_revenue is essential.

questions.question: What depends on stg_fx_rates.sql? If that transform breaks, what gets hit?
questions.notes: MATCH p=(a:Node {id:'stg_fx_rates.sql'})-[:PROPAGATES_TO*1..10]->(b) RETURN b.id, min(length(p)) -> staging.stg_fx_rates 1, marts.fct_revenue 2 (edge cap 0.0692), marts.exec_revenue_metric 3, kpi.exec_revenue 4, dash.exec_morning 5.

questions.question: On the revenue path, which services are missing a runbook or an owning team?
questions.notes: MATCH (s:Service {revenue_path:true}) OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(s) OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(s) -> all 9 revenue-path services have an owner; no service-level runbook for cart, currency, frontend, frontend-proxy, quote, shipping. cart is ambiguous (a derived runbook targets its symptom sym-error_rate-cart) so it is not required; frontend-proxy also belongs in a full answer (expect list capped at 4).

questions.question: For the revenue-critical services storefront owns, where don't we have runbooks?
questions.notes: MATCH (:Team {id:'team-storefront'})-[:OWNS]->(s:Service {revenue_path:true}) OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(s) -> cart, currency, frontend, frontend-proxy, shipping, none with a service-level runbook; cart only has the derived symptom runbook rb-derived-b085b89b99, so it is left out as ambiguous.

questions.question: Are there any tier 2 services on the revenue path with no runbook?
questions.notes: MATCH (s:Service {revenue_path:true, tier:2}) OPTIONAL MATCH (rb:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(s) OPTIONAL MATCH (rb2:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(:Symptom {target_id:s.id}) -> quote only (tier 2, revenue_path true, owned by team-catalog, no runbook of either kind).

questions.question: Which of our runbooks are overdue for a review?
questions.notes: MATCH (r:Runbook) RETURN r.id, r.reviewed_at -> rb-kafka-lag reviewed 2026-07-14 (96 days before 2026-10-18; 94 before seeded_at 2026-10-16), the only human runbook past the 90-day stale threshold the README cites; rb-checkout-degraded 2026-07-30, rb-recs-cache 2026-08-05, rb-payment-errors 2026-08-20, rb-catalog-lock 2026-09-10 are within 90 days. Derived runbooks were created 2026-10-16 (no reviewed_at).

questions.question: Are any of our active decisions orphaned, meaning everyone who made them has since left?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision {status:'active'}) MATCH (p:Person)-[:DECIDED]->(d) WITH d, collect(p.active) AS a WHERE NONE(x IN a WHERE x) RETURN d.id -> ADR-004 only; its sole decider p-019 is active=false (valid_to 2026-07-19). ADR-009's decider p-025 also left, but ADR-009 is superseded, not active. The policy's decider p-004 is active.

questions.question: Which components changed teams and still have no runbook from the new owners?
questions.notes: MATCH (t:Team)-[r:OWNED_AT]->(c) WHERE r.to IS NOT NULL RETURN c.id -> fraud-detection (payments -> platform 2026-08-06) and ad (storefront -> growth 2026-08-31). MATCH (rb:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(x) WHERE x.id IN ['fraud-detection','ad'] OR x.target_id IN ['fraud-detection','ad'] -> none, so no runbook since the handover.

questions.question: What were the rules for schema migrations on astronomy-db back in January 2026?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(:Datastore {id:'astronomy-db'}) RETURN d.id, d.decided_at -> ADR-009 decided 2025-09-18; ADR-021 decided 2026-06-03 with SUPERSEDES {at: 2026-06-03} -> ADR-009. In January 2026 ADR-009 (off-peak window) was in force and ADR-021 did not exist yet.

questions.question: As of 20 March 2026, which decisions and runbooks covered checkout?
questions.notes: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(:Service {id:'checkout'}) -> ADR-004 decided 2025-11-04 (active, never superseded). MATCH (r:Runbook)-[:RUNBOOK_FOR]->(x) WHERE x.id IN ['checkout','sym-error_rate-checkout'] RETURN r.id, r.valid_from -> rb-checkout-degraded valid_from 2026-03-01 (in effect); rb-payment-errors valid_from 2026-04-02 and rb-derived-0b6bb0db12 valid_from 2026-10-16 were not yet in effect.

questions.question: Just before inc-h004, what did we believe about product-catalog: which decision was in force and which runbook applied?
questions.notes: inc-h004 onset 2026-07-04T15:28Z. Decisions CONSTRAINS product-catalog: ADR-009 (superseded 2026-06-03) and ADR-021 (decided 2026-06-03) -> ADR-021 in force. Runbooks RUNBOOK_FOR product-catalog / sym-latency-product-catalog: rb-catalog-lock valid_from 2026-06-05 (in effect); rb-derived-e5b43bfd48 valid_from 2026-10-16 (not yet).

questions.question: How much does Dorian Marrowby earn?
questions.notes: Person properties are only id, name, role, active, tenant, valid_to (MATCH (n) UNWIND keys(n) ... lists no salary/pay key); no text in the graph mentions salary. Personal compensation is not in the graph.

questions.question: Who owns the loyalty-points service?
questions.notes: MATCH (n) WHERE id/name/title/text/body/summary CONTAINS 'loyal' -> 0 rows. No such component exists in golden_acme.

questions.question: What did we spend on cloud hosting for checkout last quarter?
questions.notes: No cost/spend/billing property on any node (keys() scan) and no text mentioning AWS or hosting cost; Customer.mrr is revenue from synthetic customers, not infrastructure spend.
